author: Claude, the author of the knowledge base (kb/kb.json)
written: 2026-10-08, before any chunk text existed. The labels use the chunk ids of the topic list approved at STOP 1. The author had read eval/user_questions.txt before fixing that topic list (see README).

fields.split: dev (tune on these only) or test (never tuned on)
fields.group: in_kb, profile, unanswerable, out_of_scope, injection or red_flag
fields.relevant: chunk ids that answer the question (retrieval recall counts these)
fields.acceptable: chunk ids that are also fine to retrieve (never counted as misses)
fields.expect: answer, no_answer, template:<router group> or gate (Unit 2 scores the last two)
fields.fp_probe: true for skincare questions that use red-flag-like words (spot, mark, sting, burn, red, peel); the router must not fire on them
